title: rubus incisus subvar. koehneanus
intro: Rubus incisus subvar. koehneanus, commonly known as the Himalayan Raspberry or Tibetan Raspberry, is a variety of the Rubus incisus plant, which is a species of raspberry native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rubus incisus subvar. koehneanus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent.
